entries.partTitle: Physics of Specular Reflections & Screen-Space Ray Generation

spec.title: System Architecture: Physics of Specular Reflections & Screen-Space Ray Generation

steps.caption: Architectural overview illustrates camera-space reflection rays spawned from surface normal and view vectors.
Deep inspection examines G-Buffer depth and normal decoding into view space positions.
Comparative analysis contrasts naive world-space ray tracing against screen-space ray reconstruction.
Verification confirms normalized reflection vector orientation and camera matrix consistency.

entries.partTitle: Linear Screen-Space Ray Marching vs Hierarchical Hi-Z Traversal

spec.title: System Architecture: Linear Screen-Space Ray Marching vs Hierarchical Hi-Z Traversal

steps.caption: Architectural overview displays the hierarchical Hi-Z depth mipmap pyramid constructed with minimum depth reductions.
Deep inspection tracks ray marching traversal across coarse mip levels skipping empty air voxels.
Comparative analysis demonstrates substantial compute savings of cell boundary stepping over linear ray marching.
Verification certifies conservative depth bounding and zero missed geometric intersections.

entries.partTitle: Binary Search Intersection Refinement & Depth Precision

spec.title: System Architecture: Binary Search Intersection Refinement & Depth Precision

steps.caption: Architectural overview shows binary search refinement narrowing coarse ray intersections down to sub-pixel accuracy.
Deep inspection evaluates geometric thickness thresholds to distinguish true surface hits from background passthroughs.
Comparative analysis contrasts single-step linear hits against four-iteration binary boundary convergence.
Verification confirms depth penetration bounds and elimination of floating mirror artifacts.

entries.partTitle: Fresnel Attenuation, Surface Roughness & Screen-Edge Fade Falloff

spec.title: System Architecture: Fresnel Attenuation, Surface Roughness & Screen-Edge Fade Falloff

steps.caption: Architectural overview illustrates Schlick Fresnel reflectivity blending sharp specular reflections with diffuse base color.
Deep inspection tracks roughness-based ray cone expansion and specular fade at screen edges.
Comparative analysis benchmarks pure screen-space reflections against pre-filtered environment cubemap fallbacks.
Verification certifies seamless edge fading and smooth roughness attenuation across surfaces.
